note: caption groups: words per caption, in script order (max 3 words; exceptions: the hook line = ONE card on two lines, and the quoted comment in the call to action, which the brief asks for as one card). cards = per-card options (br: words on the first line of a two-line card, fs: base size, x / maxW: own centre and width, style). w100 = real width of each card's widest line at 100 px, written by scripts/captionsizes.mjs
